concept: Sales AI should answer to the rep
canonicalExplanation: Keel believes sales AI should work for the individual rep — private by default, no manager view, no admin seat. The rep owns the data and the output. This is a design position, not a feature toggle: a dormant manager tier is still a manager tier.
avoidWhen: implying team visibility is never legitimate — Gong is good at the job it was built for
